links.outcome: Clinician expert preference among AI explanation formats
links.effect: 28 clinical experts indicated a strong preference for novel concept-guided explanations, especially hybrid graph-and-text summary formats.
links.quote: Explanation formats were evaluated by 28 clinical experts who indicated a strong preference for our novel concept-guided explanations, especially hybrid graph-and-text summary formats.

unlisted_practices: Co-developing explanation formats with clinicians for a psychosis risk prediction NLP model

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an NLP/LLM pipeline for psychosis risk prediction and tests novel clinician-co-designed SHAP explanation formats with 28 clinical experts.
